Quasipolynomial construction of a pure approximate Bayes-Nash equilibrium under independent uniform types and existence of a pure equilibrium
Randomized hidden-clique reduction to near-optimal (one-half minus eta) approximate Nash equilibrium

semantic_independence_note: One constructive pure Bayesian-equilibrium algorithm for uniform independent type pairs with an existing pure BNE. The guessing claim, LP and purification are uncounted new local core. Approved1536 is a hidden-clique-to-near-optimal non-Bayesian equilibrium reduction; untouched1537 is a small-support hardness target. Neither is this Bayesian algorithm, nor a hypothesis/helper/parameter instance of it. Same dedup key absent elsewhere.
